name: Tooltip Layer
description: A viewport-aware tooltip presenter for items, abilities, resources, and controls. It normalizes rich text sections, pins or dismisses one tooltip at a time, and flips placement to remain inside safe bounds. It displays supplied metadata and never inspects or mutates the underlying inventory, ability, or economy state.

outputs.name: visibleTooltip
outputs.description: Current model as {sourceId, title, subtitle, sections, rarity, pinned}; section content is host-supplied display data.

outputs.name: placement
outputs.description: Resolved rectangle and anchor side after viewport collision handling.
